title: Approved leave is deducted from the balance; pending and rejected leave is not
intent: As the employee, note the remaining leave days, then submit one request covering three consecutive days and a second request covering two consecutive days in a different week. As the manager, approve the three-day request and reject the two-day request. Check the employee's remaining days at each stage the assertions describe.

assertions.description: Employee's remaining days while both requests are still pending
Employee's remaining days after the three-day request is approved and before the other request is decided
Employee's remaining days after the two-day request is rejected
